blurb: Higgsfield AI is an AI video generation platform that marketed itself heavily on X (formerly Twitter) before its account was suspended on February 9, 2026. The company posted about AI video tools, often promoting features like 'Unlimited Kling AI 3.0' access. Its follower count is not publicly available due to the suspension.
credibility_note: The account was suspended following a pattern of marketing promises that outpaced product delivery, including claims of 'unlimited' access that were contradicted by users and Kling AI itself. The suspension likely resulted from violations of X's anti-manipulation policies.

sources.title: Higgsfield AI's X Ban: A Case Study in How Platform Trust Collapses
